phases.name: Backend Services & Storage
phases.description: Build template management, metrics collection, and export/import services

subtasks.description: Create team template service with CRUD operations
subtasks.notes: Created TeamTemplateService.swift with full CRUD operations following TeamsFileService patterns. Service uses actor for thread safety, atomic writes, validation, and stores templates in ~/.claude/team-templates/{id}.json. Also created PaginationParams.swift utility to fix pre-existing build errors in controllers. Build verified successful. Committed with hash 32bb709.

subtasks.description: Create team metrics service for performance tracking
subtasks.notes: Created TeamMetricsService.swift following SystemMetricsService pattern. Implements comprehensive team performance tracking with methods for: getTeamMetrics() (full team metrics snapshot), getAgentPerformance() (individual agent metrics), getTeamSummary() (dashboard summary), and getTimeSeries() (trend analysis). Calculates agent stats, task stats, performance metrics, workload distribution, health scores, and efficiency ratings. Uses actor isolation for thread safety and dependency injection for TeamsFileService. All calculations follow established patterns with proper error handling and documentation. Build verified successful. Committed with hash f8d59eb.
Added export/import methods to TeamsFileService. Implemented exportTeam() to bundle all team data and importTeam() to recreate teams from exported data. Build verified successfully.

phases.name: Backend API Endpoints
phases.description: Add REST API endpoints for templates, metrics, and export/import

subtasks.notes: Added template endpoints to TeamsController with full CRUD operations: listTemplates, getTemplate, createTemplate, updateTemplate, deleteTemplate, and applyTemplate. Injected TeamTemplateService dependency in routes.swift. All endpoints follow existing controller patterns with proper validation, error handling, and APIResponse wrappers. API verification successful - GET /api/v1/teams/templates returns 200 with expected JSON format. Committed with hash efa296f.

Added GET /teams/:name/metrics endpoint that returns comprehensive team metrics including agent stats (total, active, idle, errored), task stats (total, completed, in progress, pending, failed, success rate), performance metrics (efficiency score, collaboration score, etc.), and workload distribution per agent. Verified with curl test - returns HTTP 200 with proper JSON response.

Added export/import endpoints to TeamsController. Export endpoint (GET /teams/:name/export) returns full team configuration including members, tasks, and messages. Import endpoint (POST /teams/import) creates team from exported data with optional overwrite flag. Leveraged existing TeamsFileService methods. Build verified successfully.

description:
# Advanced Multi-Agent Team Coordination

Enhanced team coordination features including visual workflow builder, agent task dependencies, team templates, and performance analytics. Build on existing teams feature to create true orchestration capability.

## Rationale
Multi-agent team coordination is completely missing from competitors (gap-6). This is a massive differentiator. Enhancing the existing teams feature solidifies ILS's unique market position.

## User Stories
- As a team lead, I want to visually design multi-agent workflows so that I can coordinate complex tasks
- As a developer, I want to use pre-built team templates so that I can quickly set up common workflows

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Visual workflow builder with drag-and-drop agent arrangement
- [ ] Task dependencies and execution order configuration
- [ ] Pre-built team templates for common workflows
- [ ] Real-time team progress dashboard
- [ ] Agent performance metrics and comparisons
- [ ] Team configuration export/import
- [ ] Notification when team workflow completes
